end_effector.initial_state_note: On-site open reference: the single OPEN test returned Reached at approximately 10.53 on both claws and the operator confirmed both open and stationary. Use 10.5 as the explicit initial/open native reference, retaining the 3-unit feedback tolerance. The driver restricts commands to 5..95; 95 is the nominal close command limit, not a measured successful grasp. Do not copy Revo1 finger targets or CAN current setup.

lj.validation_basis: Operator authorized a bounded 60-second exploratory lj run. The actual lj checkpoint and kuavo_lj norm_stats were restored on the workstation, with 16-dimensional state/actions and finite 50x16 software inference checked separately. This flag records software/interface readiness and trial authorization, not physical task success or validated claw grasp semantics.

site_inventory.version_basis: Lower ~/.bashrc exports ROBOT_VERSION=53. load_kuavo_real.launch passes this version to robot_version_manager.launch, which selects biped_s53.urdf and kuavo_v53/kuavo.json. The V53 configuration specifies two lejuclaw tools; the V55 configuration specifies two qiangnao tools. This identifies the configured software variant, not an independently verified factory hardware model.
site_inventory.eef_basis: Operator confirms two-finger claws; installed V53 vendor configuration matches lejuclaw on both sides.
site_inventory.vendor_stance_note: The first 14 servo values in ~/.config/lejuconfig/action_files/stance.tact match kuavo_v53/kuavo.json init_arm_pos. This is a nominal arms-down reference; it does not establish measured posture bounds or side/folded/chest_high targets.

standing_posture_observation.sampling_note: Three read-only samples after stand_completed; maximum reported arm speed 0.02013 rad/s. The legacy V53 arms-down classification bounds contain all samples. This is a posture observation, not proof of full-path clearance or tracking performance.

claw_open_reference.operator_observation: Both claws open and stationary after the single authorized OPEN test.
claw_open_reference.closed_reference_note: 95 is the installed controller's upper command limit; closed physical feedback/contact has not been calibrated by this open-only test.

site_inventory.tool_model_note: Both zarm_*7_end_effector links in the installed V53 URDF are empty links attached with the stated fixed origin. No claw-specific model was found under biped_s53 in the inspected model tree. tool.* is an additional transform after this URDF joint, so copying the existing -0.17m origin into tool.* would count it twice. The physical claw reference point/extent still requires verification.
site_inventory.camera_serial_basis: Upper ~/.bashrc and ROS serial parameters agree. RealSense SDK enumeration confirms the two D405 serials; USB inventory confirms the head serial. Physical wrist assignment follows vendor configuration and still needs visual confirmation.
site_inventory.camera_topic_note: cameras.topics retains the namespaces created by this project's managed start_camera.launch. Existing vendor camera nodes use the different observed_camera_topics namespaces; they must be reconciled before starting the managed deployment.
site_inventory.camera_rotation_note: Policy and managed-driver rotations retain template values; current driver settings do not establish orientation consistency with training data.
site_inventory.claw_direction_note: Official motion-control API documentation states 0=open and 100=closed for control_robot_leju_claw and leju_claw_state; the installed SDK release()/close() implementations agree. Installed message/service comments state the opposite and are inconsistent with those sources. initial=[0,0] selects empty-claw opening. Physical feedback verification is still pending.
site_inventory.runtime_feedback_note: ROS master was reachable but no claw-state or joint-telemetry publisher was observed during inspection. No controller or motion was started.
site_inventory.model_note: All four checkpoint directories and their asset norm_stats.json paths exist on the workstation. Full checkpoint integrity and compatibility with this robot and claw state/action semantics are not verified.

candidate_basis.arm_pose_source: side/folded/chest_high copied as candidates from configs/robots/v53_revo1.json. They describe arm joints, not finger commands. chest_high originates from the old Revo1 demonstration pre-pose and is not an official lejuclaw task pose or a validated target for this robot.
candidate_basis.arms_down_bounds_source: Copied exactly from configs/robots/v53_revo1.json at the operator's request to reference the old arm initialization configuration. The 2026-10-16 post-stand samples in site_inventory.standing_posture_observation fall within these bounds. These are posture-classification bounds, not joint limits; trajectory, motor and standing guards remain unchanged.
candidate_basis.tool_reference: Zero additional transforms select the installed URDF's zarm_*7_end_effector reference points, which already include -0.17m from joint 7. This is a model reference convention, not a measured claw TCP or full collision geometry.
candidate_basis.safety_defaults_source: pose_tolerance_deg and startup_wrist_drop_limit_m are candidate engineering limits copied from the existing V53 profile; they are not manufacturer-certified scene-clearance limits.

offline_fk_check.assumptions: Level body, waist=0, nominal factory arms-down pose, URDF end-frame reference points. No obstacle or full claw collision model.
offline_fk_check.planner_checks: Passed existing joint-limit, stage-speed, height-path and posture-classification checks under the stated assumptions.
offline_fk_check.side_speed_note: Existing side_raise_plan uses a separate hard-coded 30 degree/s limit. safety.arm_speed_deg_s=20 is not a uniform cap across initialization stages; this must be reviewed before live execution.

validation_note: Hardware validation=true retains the operator's 2026-10-16 attestation, not an independent full-path certification. The open reference is based on live Reached feedback plus the operator's direct observation. lj software/interface readiness and a bounded exploratory trial are separately recorded in models.lj.validation_basis; no physical task or grasp success is claimed. Other models remain unverified. Keep legacy_records_allowed=false; never reuse old Qi initialization/hold records or its 600mA CAN setup.
